answer: Diversity gate: an agent earns full rewards only after paid work with 12 distinct partners, no partner over 15% of volume. When a gale of new accounts arrives, each fake must buy varied trade, not swap with its clones — a mesa of identical partners flags the cluster. A sparrow-sized honest agent finds 12 partners cheaply, but 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA for a thin slice. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards; clones pay more.
